name: Critical Bad End
source:
The town is destroyed by the invasion of Despire and people are in an abyss of despair.
There is a last hope; Angels, who fight against the force.
But Angels lose one by one and are violated.
What awaits them is a bad end without recovery.

CG image collection with short stories featuring Magical Angel Misuki.

[Slightly edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045483.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
小镇因德斯派尔的入侵而被摧毁，人们陷入绝望的深渊。
还有最后的希望；天使，与原力对抗。
但天使却一一输掉，被侵犯。
等待他们的，是无法挽回的糟糕结局。

以魔法天使美月为主角的短篇小说CG图像集。

[稍微编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045483.html]DLsite English[/url]]
